name: ThemeSwitcher
description: The ThemeSwitcher component provides a combined UI element that groups together theme mode controls (light/dark/system) and theme color controls in a single, cohesive interface.
usage: Provides complete theme customization in a single UI element
Improves UI organization for theme controls
Responsive design works well in different container sizes
A CSS gap (space-x-2) ensures consistent spacing between elements
Does not add unnecessary wrapper elements or styles to the individual components
examples:
// In a navigation header
<header className="flex justify-between items-center p-4">
  <Logo />
  <nav>
    {/* Navigation links */}
  </nav>
  <ThemeSwitcher />
</header>
design: Combines ThemeToggle (for switching between light, dark, and system color modes) and ThemeColorButton (for cycling through available color themes)
Components are arranged horizontally with appropriate spacing, creating a unified theme control section
accessibility: Container has role="group" and aria-label="Theme controls" for proper screen reader announcement
Individual buttons maintain their accessibility attributes
Consistent sizing ensures touch targets are appropriately sized
